Harper (PM): Quick follow-up from the all-hands Q&A — customers keep asking for specific windows for Hosted API streaming fixes, Console cost visuals, and Optimize recommendations. Can leadership confirm a concise timeline and any hard blockers?
Lee (VP Product): High level: streaming perf GA -> late July (staged), console cost visuals -> public beta mid-August, Optimize invite beta -> September. Blockers: perf regressions, billing schema, and metrics retention.
Harper (PM): Can we call out which teams own the blockers so customer comms are accurate?
Alex (Eng): Perf regressions: 1) attention padding tail-latency (owner: Sanjay), 2) KV eviction on cold-start (owner: Mira). Both have PRs; needs validation in canary.
Jonah (CTO): Billing schema change is small but requires SDK and internal consumers to adapt. We'll keep it backward-compatible externally. Owner: Alex.
Priya (PMM): For public messaging, should we use month windows or quarters? Sales asks for month to plan outreach.
Lee (VP Product): Use month buckets but label as "target" and call out gating criteria. If canary fails we push.
Samira (DevEx): Docs plan: publish an alpha note for API changes now, migration guide when beta opens. I'll coordinate SDK owners to freeze breaking changes during beta.
ops-bot: Canary window scheduled: 2026-06-28T02:00:00Z -> 2026-06-30T02:00:00Z. Target: 2% opt-in traffic.
Alex (Eng): Canary will include tracing + rollback hooks. If p99 > 2x baseline we abort and revert.
Harper (PM): Action items: Alex to track billing PR + canary metrics, Samira to draft alpha docs, Priya to prep customer note, Lee to finalize gating checklist. I'll post the compiled timeline + action tracker in #product by COB Friday.
Lee (VP Product): One more — mark Console cost visuals as "beta" in external comms until legal and billing checks are done.
Priya (PMM): Got it. I'll prepare conservative and optimistic messaging for sales.
Harper (PM): Thanks — will follow up with the doc. :white_check_mark:
